captions.text: Now choose where Job Explorer looks for jobs.
The main source is companies you watch.
Paste a company's careers page from Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, or SmartRecruiters, then click add company.
Every time a search runs, it checks every company on your list, and keeps only the jobs that pass your filters.
You can watch as many companies as you like.
If you use a cloud AI key, find companies can search the web for employers that hire for your job title.
Below, you can add USAJOBS for federal jobs in the United States, with a free key.
And you can block companies you never want to see, like your current employer.
